privacidad.title: Privacy policy
privacidad.note: Initial template. To be reviewed by counsel before launch.

sections.body: We collect only what you share when you apply or contact us: name, work email, company, and your project description. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.
We use your data only to evaluate your application, reply, and maintain our professional relationship. We never sell or share your data with third parties.
We retain your data only as long as needed for the purposes described and apply reasonable, industry-standard security controls.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by writing to contact@axenorcorporations.com.
